name: ZeBRa ~Ryoshuu no Yakata~
source:
Main character works as a butler, but he has a secret cruel personality behind the respectable facade. His evil side co-exists peacefully inside him and is never revealed. Something really serious must happen for it to break through. And something strange indeed happens...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
